newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hwa Kay Thai proposes rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Hwa Kay Thai proposes rights issue.

text.p: Hwa Kay Thai Holdings Ltd proposed a one-for-one rights issue at HK$0.50 per share to raise HK$502.44 million shortly after it announced a 83 percent drop on its 1995/96 annual profit.

The price represents a discount of 34.2 percent to Hwa Kay Thai shares' closing of HK$0.76 on August 27, and a discount of 20.6 percent to the theoretical ex-rights price of the share of HK$0.63 based on their Tuesday close, it said on Wednesday.
Worldsec Corporate Finance Ltd is the financial adviser and underwriter of the issue. Hwa Kay Thai distributes and markets Puma brand products and operates restaurants.
The company said it would use proceeds from the issue for working capital and reducing borrowings.
Hwa Kay Thai posted a net profit of HK$12.47 million for the year ended March 31 against HK$71.29 million a year earlier.

It attributed the sharp profit fall to weak consumer sentiment and mixed results from major operating divisions, capital gains from the realisation of property and profit from its Thai associated company.
Tanayong Public Co Ltd contributed a net profit of HK$12 million for 1995/96, down 83 percent from the year before, the company said. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
